{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for internal QA orders: look for revenue_clean = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Print the number of QA orders found
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the required numbers
print(f'Number of completed orders: {len(completed_orders)}')
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}')"}
